title: Compact Bellman-Grounded Cognitive Maps for Cost-Aware Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2609.05104v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Biological agents navigate familiar environments not by re-solving routes for each new goal, but by reusing a learned map built once and read off as goals change. Existing artificial cognitive-map models mimic this reuse, yet their guidance is not explicitly grounded in additive heterogeneous route costs. Furthermore, they often struggle with memory efficiency: representative state-indexed and high-rank spectral constructions incur substantial storage growth as the environment scales. We present BCM, which grounds a reusable cognitive map in local edge costs through a self-supervised Bellman-grounded objective and a compact coordinate encoding, supporting changing goal queries without per-goal retraining. On weighted grids of up to $N=1600$ nodes, BCM maintains full success and only a 5\% mean Gap relative to exact Dijkstra search, compared with about $45\%$ for a connectivity-based spectral baseline. translated_title: 面向代价感知导航的紧凑型贝尔曼接地认知地图
translated_abstract: 生物智能体在熟悉环境中导航时，并非为每个新目标重新求解路径，而是复用一次性构建好的学习地图，并随目标变化直接从中读取导航信息。现有的人工认知地图模型虽然模仿了这种复用机制，但其导航引导并未显式建立在可加的异构路径代价之上。此外，这些模型往往在内存效率上表现不佳：具有代表性的状态索引式构造和高秩谱方法构造会随环境规模扩大而导致存储需求大幅增长。我们提出了BCM，它通过自监督的贝尔曼接地目标和紧凑的坐标编码，将可复用的认知地图接地于局部边代价之上，支持目标动态变化的查询而无需针对每个目标重新训练。在节点数多达 N=1600 的加权网格上，BCM 保持了完全的导航成功率，且相对于精确的 Dijkstra 搜索仅有 5% 的平均代价差距，而基于连通性的谱方法基线的差距约为 45%。值得注意的是，随着图规模的增大……
tldr: 本文提出BCM模型，通过自监督贝尔曼接地目标和紧凑坐标编码构建可复用的认知地图，无需针对每个目标重新训练即可支持动态目标查询，在1600节点的加权网格上实现了与精确Dijkstra搜索仅5%的平均代价差距，远优于约45%差距的谱方法基线，同时大幅降低了存储开销。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes BCM, a compact cognitive map grounded in local edge costs via a self-supervised Bellman objective and compact coordinate encoding, which supports changing goal queries without per-goal retraining and achieves only a 5% mean cost gap relative to exact Dijkstra search on 1600-node weighted grids, versus about 45% for a spectral baseline, while substantially reducing memory requirements.
